dac_amortisation / dac_additions: the movement table is printed only in the annual report (here only the net change appears in the cash-flow statement)
notes: Source is the managing company own report (הפניקס פנסיה וגמל בע"מ, ח.פ. 513026484, wholly owned by Phoenix Financial), public on fnx.co.il; no parent figures used. Operating segments figures are the consolidated note (the solo appendix is ignored).

Segment keys follow the printed columns of the fund-type tables, as in the sibling files for earlier periods in this folder: pension_veteran (ותיקות), pension_new_comprehensive (מקיפה), pension_new_general (משלימה / כללית), provident_gemel (קופת גמל לתגמולים ואישית לפיצויים), provident_study_fund (קרן השתלמות), provident_investment (קופת גמל להשקעה), provident_child_savings (חיסכון לכל ילד), provident_central_severance, provident_central_annuity (מרכזיות), other (אחר), total (סך הכל = pension + provident together). No new-pension or provident aggregate is printed in these tables: build pension_new = comprehensive + general and provident = the provident columns downstream; the only printed provident aggregate is in the directors report narrative (metrics aum, deposits, withdrawals, net_transfers, net_flows, segment provident, NIS millions).
Segments pension / provident in the P&L metrics = ניהול קרנות פנסיה / ניהול קופות גמל columns of the operating segments note; total = printed סך הכל column.

Windows: tables are cumulative from 1 January (Q1 = 3 months, window q equal to ytd; Q2 = 6 months and Q3 = 9 months, window ytd; 31.12 = fy). Income statement and segment note also print three-month columns (window q). Each report also prints the prior-year same-period block and the prior year-end block; all are taken with their own date. A printed '-' is stored as 0 with a note; parentheses are negative.

selling_and_marketing_expenses = עמלות, הוצאות שיווק והוצאות רכישה אחרות; per the commissions note it is net of acquisition commissions deferred in the year and includes amortisation of deferred acquisition costs (FY2025: acquisition expenses 234,326 equal the DAC amortisation line of note 5). Fund-table amounts in NIS thousands; narrative amounts in NIS millions as printed (approximate, כ).
